sources.title: Amazon 2025 Form 10-K: Business, Technology and Infrastructure, Segment Information
Amazon fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results, February 5, 2026: net-sales categories and definitions

input_statements.text: We report three operating segments: North America, International, and our cloud-services business.
Both regional segments encompass retail sales, seller activity, advertising and subscriptions, so each reporting segment spans multiple offerings.
Consumers buy products through our online and physical stores; products may be sold by us or by independent third-party sellers.
Our seller programs let third parties sell in our stores and use our fulfillment services; we are not the seller of record.
Our cloud division sells computing, storage and database services to developers and enterprises; shared technology infrastructure also serves our internal needs.
Our consumer membership combines shipping benefits with access to entertainment, including movies, series and live sports.
Seller-service revenue includes sales commissions plus fulfillment and shipping fees for services provided to third-party sellers.
Advertising customers include sellers, vendors, publishers and authors; they can buy sponsored, display and video advertising.
Subscription revenue includes consumer membership fees and digital video, music, audiobook and ebook subscriptions, excluding cloud-service subscriptions.
Individual digital-media purchases count as online-store sales, while subscriptions granting ongoing viewing or usage rights count as subscription services.
Online orders collected at physical stores remain online-store sales; physical-store sales cover products customers select while visiting a store.
Paid-unit measures include items sold by us and third-party sellers; these item counts are distinct from our net-sales revenue categories.

expected_checks.description: Separate regional segment classifications from offering hierarchy.
Distinguish consumers, third-party sellers and advertising customers.
Nest computing, storage and databases under cloud services.
Represent shared infrastructure serving internal operations and cloud customers.
Connect membership to shipping and entertainment benefits.
Keep seller fees and paid-unit metrics distinct.
Preserve transaction-versus-subscription and order-channel classification rules.

deliberately_unspecified: Exact prices, commission percentages, subscription rates and contract terms.
Country-level availability and the complete geographic footprint of each offering.
Complete product catalog, brands, legal entities and organizational ownership.
Transaction volumes, revenue totals, margins and customer-level economics.
